mapper.select:
select f.FINPROD_ID id, f.FINPROD_ABBR text from FIN_PRODUCT f where 1=1
and f.FINPROD_TYPE=#{finprodType}
AND ( FINPROD_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
AND F.FINPROD_ID IN ( select a.finprod_id from trd_product_deal a where a.finprod_type = #{finprodType} union
select a.pledge_finprod_id from FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE a INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID where b.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType})
